definitions.curve: median outcomes at each exact value of k (action count, duration in days, prize units, description word count or share worth), only where the group has at least the stated campaigns and organizers
definitions.conversion: valid_contestants / impressions, median across campaigns in the group
definitions.epe: entries per entrant, valid_entries / valid_contestants, median across campaigns in the group
definitions.breakpoint: a two-segment straight-line fit tried at every possible split of the curve; the split with the lowest combined error is reported, with the slope on each side and how much that split beats a single straight line through the whole curve (near 0 means the data does not support a break at all)
definitions.by_stratum: the same breakpoint search repeated within each industry (at least ten organizers), size band and plan tier. A breakpoint that lands in a different place per stratum is not a rule, it is stratification noise
definitions.winner_units: sum of prize quantity per campaign, the closest available proxy to a winner count. wins and all_winners_drawn are never used by repo rule
definitions.n_units_scope: ordinary campaigns (1,000+ contestants), not restricted to clean
definitions.duration_scope: ordinary campaigns with no repeatable action (loyalty, timed bonus or bonus custom action), not restricted to 14 days or fewer, so the elbow can be seen past the clean cutoff
definitions.action_count_scope: clean campaigns only (no repeatable action, 14 days or fewer), to avoid conflating action count with the drip mechanics of long-running campaigns
definitions.description_length_scope: clean campaigns, word count of the campaign description
definitions.share_worth_scope: ordinary campaigns with a share action carrying a fixed (non-variable) worth
definitions.size_deciles: ordinary campaigns split into ten equal-count groups by contestants, from smallest to largest, to see whether entries per entrant or conversion bend at a particular size rather than sliding smoothly
